why_it_moved.text: The test arm differs from control in two settings: the ranker model, and snippet length. Only the ranker was meant to change.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Longer snippets could raise successful searches by themselves, so the lift may not come from the ranker.
why_it_moved.label: guess

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts or daily series are in the scorecard, so the mechanism is unknown.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A rerun, or a split of the data, where snippet length is the same in both arms would settle whether the ranker alone clears the bar.
A pre-registration note that the snippet change was intended, with evidence, would turn this into an escalation.
A daily series by days since first exposure would let us check the lift is not fading.
